claims.claim: The operator passes its resolved governed repository to durable REMEDIATION and REPAIR profile lookup, collision, replay, dispatch, and RUN-binding calls. Both dispatch modules validate v2 profiles against that repository’s policy file by exact path.

External-repository regressions accept repo_only profiles and reject profiles unsupported by the governed repository, including profiles supported by the AIOS checkout policy. Missing and malformed governed policies fail closed on existing-record reads.
Existing durable records return their bound model, effort, and source provenance without resolving current defaults or rewriting the record.
The v1 replay branches and existing locking, RUN matching, and reconciliation logic remain in place in both dispatch modules; the focused dispatch test files passed.

Deterministic dispatch and operator regressions exercise both correction families with temporary governed-repository policies that differ from the AIOS checkout policy, including reads after write, replay, collision, reconciliation, and rejection paths.
The committed implementation changes exactly the six authorized files and adds no lifecycle authority, fallback, routing, or retry behavior.
